entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this helmet I bought. This is ridiculous.

I can certainly look into that for you. I understand you're calling about the Urban Commuter Helmet. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference? The color is completely wrong! It looks nothing like the picture online. I'm not wearing this thing. I want my money back, now. I haven't even taken it out, the box is unopened!
I'm sorry to hear that the color wasn't what you expected. I can definitely understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order information.
You'd better. I'm not wasting my whole day on this. If you give me any trouble, I'll be speaking to a manager and leaving a review on every single website you can imagine.
I understand your position. There's no need for that, I'm happy to resolve this for you. Okay, I see your order. You received the helmet 8 days ago. Let me just check the policy.
There's nothing to check! Just process the return. It's that simple.

You are absolutely right. My apologies. I can see here that our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can approve this return for you immediately. No problem at all.
Wait, really? Just like that? No restocking fee or anything?

That's correct. No fees. Especially since the box is unopened. At VeloFit, your satisfaction and safety are our main priorities. I am emailing you a prepaid return label as we speak. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Huh. Okay. Well, good. That's what I expected in the first place. When will I get my refund?

Once the warehouse receives the helmet and confirms its condition, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. You'll get an email notification as soon as it's initiated.
Alright, fine. I see the email just came through. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
